summary.text: Chuck Owen is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 30, representing Beauregard and Vernon, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.
The page lists Chuck Owen with committee assignments including Special Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs (Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Chuck Owen's occupation as Consultant and Adjunct Faculty Member; Retired Military Officer.

It lists Chuck Owen's education as Leesville High School, 1981; B.S., Louisiana Tech University, 1984 (cum laude); M.S., Business Administration, Louisiana Tech University, 1986; Ph.D., Louisiana State University, 2011.

The House member page lists Chuck Owen's committee assignments as Appropriations; Education; Judiciary; Special Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs (Chair); House Select Committee on Homeland Security (Vice Chair); Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
